question: Which Indian American-led start-up was awarded the 'National Science Foundation Innovation-Corps (NSF I-Corps) Teams Award' on 11 August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SoftWorthy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The coveted National Science Foundation Innovation-Corps (NSF I-Corps) Teams Award has been given to **SoftWorthy in the US.**
 
• **The award-winning project of SoftWorthy**, which was established in 2020, is dedicated to creating cutting-edge computational techniques for** "stochastic modelling, design simulation, and sensitivity analysis of electronic devices like printed-circuit-boards (PCBs), which are essential for the development of cutting-edge technological applications like driverless cars and energy-efficient smart buildings.**
 
• The business has been working to create cutting-edge software technology for carrying out engineering analysis.
 
• It is run by a group of Indian engineers who received their training at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Harvard University. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Zenefits **has all the HR tools you need to manage your workforce effectively, including performance appraisals, org charts, and easy PTO tracking, among many other features.
 
• San Jose, California serves as the home base for the publicly traded **Bloom Energy**.
 
• It produces and sells on-site electricity-generating solid oxide fuel cells.
 
• An American business called **Instacart **provides grocery delivery and pickup services in both the US and Canada.
